Messages.Author: jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Well, if you don't know what a meme is, then welcome to the internet
Start here:
en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internet_meme
www.knowyourmeme.com

But the ones that Ossian is specifically making fun of (so far) are mostly the crap being spread around on facebook/social media. People posting their status messages as images, or misattributing quotes, or the "people see me as..." meme, etc etc.

It's funny for 2 reasons:
1) Ossian humor is absurd and silly.
2) All of those memes suck, and everyone is thinking it even when they participate.
